tools.name: progression_for_exercise
tools.title: Progression for exercise
tools.description: Per-session set count, top weight, and volume for an exercise (matched by partial name), for the authenticated user.

tools.name: sets_for_exercise
tools.title: Sets for exercise
tools.description: Every individual logged set for an exercise (matched by partial name), ungrouped — performed_on, set_number, weight, and reps — for the authenticated user.

tools.name: weekly_volume
tools.title: Weekly volume
tools.description: Sessions and total volume per week for the authenticated user.

tools.name: training_gaps
tools.title: Training gaps
tools.description: Days elapsed between consecutive training sessions for the authenticated user.

tools.name: get_day_templates
tools.title: Day templates
tools.description: The authenticated user's day templates with their ordered exercises and each exercise's day-specific progressive scheme, or its uniform defaults when none is set.

tools.name: get_workout_history
tools.title: Workout history
tools.description: The authenticated user's full raw session history: every session with its date, associated day, and every logged set, unaggregated. Optionally filter by date range (start_date/end_date) and/or a partial exercise-name match; omit all filters for the full history.

start_date.description: Only include sessions performed on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

end_date.description: Only include sessions performed on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

exercise_name.description: Only include sets for exercises whose name partially matches this (case-insensitive).

tools.name: scheme_history_for_day_exercise
tools.title: Scheme history for day/exercise
tools.description: Every recorded progressive-scheme version for a (workout_day_id, exercise_id) pair, ordered by recorded_at, for the authenticated user — use a <= filter on recorded_at and take the latest row to find which scheme was in effect at or before a given date.

tools.name: adherence_for_day
tools.title: Adherence for day
tools.description: Compares the authenticated user's actual logged sets against the prescribed target for the same (day, exercise) pairing and session date - the scheme actually in effect on that date (via point-in-time history), falling back to the exercise's uniform defaults when no scheme was ever defined. Flags under-/over-shooting on sets, reps, and weight. Optionally filter by workout_day_id and/or a date range (start_date/end_date); omit all filters for every day and date.

workout_day_id.description: Only include sessions for this workout day.

start_date.description: Only include sessions performed on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

end_date.description: Only include sessions performed on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

tools.name: create_day_template
tools.title: Create day template
tools.description: Creates a new, empty day template for the authenticated user. Returns the new day, including its id. If program_id is given, appends the day to the end of that program.

tools.name: rename_day_template
tools.title: Rename day template
tools.description: Renames an existing day template belonging to the authenticated user, targeted by id.

tools.name: delete_day_template
tools.title: Delete day template
tools.description: Soft-deletes a day template belonging to the authenticated user, targeted by id: marks it deleted so it no longer appears in get_day_templates or accepts further edits, but its exercise attachments, scheme history, and any sessions that referenced it are left untouched — historical scheme_history_for_day_exercise/adherence_for_day lookups keep working.

tools.name: create_exercise
tools.title: Create exercise
tools.description: Creates a catalog exercise not yet attached to any day, for the authenticated user. Omitted optionals fall back to the same defaults as the exercises table's own column defaults.

tools.name: update_exercise
tools.title: Update exercise
tools.description: Partially updates a catalog exercise belonging to the authenticated user, targeted by id. Only the fields supplied are changed; any field left out keeps its current value.

tools.name: list_exercises
tools.title: List exercises
tools.description: Every catalog exercise for the authenticated user, including ones not attached to any day. Excludes soft-deleted exercises.

tools.name: delete_exercise
tools.title: Delete exercise
tools.description: Soft-deletes a catalog exercise belonging to the authenticated user, targeted by id: marks it deleted so it no longer appears in list_exercises. Rejected outright if the exercise is still attached to any day or referenced by logged sets/scheme history — detach it from days first via remove_exercise_from_day.

tools.name: add_exercise_to_day
tools.title: Add exercise to day
tools.description: Appends an existing catalog exercise to the end of a day template's exercise list, for the authenticated user.

tools.name: remove_exercise_from_day
tools.title: Remove exercise from day
tools.description: Removes one exercise from a day template, for the authenticated user. Touches only that one attachment.

tools.name: reorder_day_exercises
tools.title: Reorder day exercises
tools.description: Rewrites a day template's exercise order for the authenticated user. exercise_ids must be exactly the day's current exercise-id set (same members, any order); membership changes must go through add_exercise_to_day/remove_exercise_from_day instead.

tools.name: set_day_exercise_scheme
tools.title: Set day exercise scheme
tools.description: Sets the day-specific rep/weight scheme for one exercise on one day, for the authenticated user. null (or an empty array) clears it, reverting that exercise to its own uniform defaults on that day.

tools.name: create_program
tools.title: Create program
tools.description: Creates a new, empty program for the authenticated user. Returns it, including its id.

tools.name: rename_program
tools.title: Rename program
tools.description: Renames an existing program belonging to the authenticated user, targeted by id.

tools.name: delete_program
tools.title: Delete program
tools.description: Soft-deletes a program belonging to the authenticated user, targeted by id: it's no longer a valid target for other program tools, but member days keep their program_id/program_position (not unassigned), so the program's structure and completion history survive and get_day_templates treats its former days as untracked (always available) in the meantime.

tools.name: add_day_to_program
tools.title: Add day to program
tools.description: Assigns an existing day template to a program, appended at the end. Errors if the day already belongs to a program; use remove_day_from_program first to reassign it.

tools.name: remove_day_from_program
tools.title: Remove day from program
tools.description: Clears a day template's program assignment, reverting it to untracked (always available).

tools.name: reorder_program_days
tools.title: Reorder program days
tools.description: Rewrites a program's day order for the authenticated user. day_ids must be exactly the program's current membership (same members, any order); membership changes must go through add_day_to_program/remove_day_from_program instead.
